comment: QA Mart Testing Plugin hooks. Scripts are Node.js CommonJS and read the tool event as JSON on stdin. PLUGIN_ROOT is the plugin folder.

preToolUse.comment: Blocks edits outside tests/, pages/ and qamart-testing-plugin/. Edits in app/, src/ and public/ are denied with a message.

postToolUse.comment: Warns about waitForTimeout, missing assertions, CSS selectors where getByTestId fits, and XPath in edited specs and Page Objects. Never blocks.
Appends timestamp, tool, agent, action and result for every tool call to hooks/qamart-plugin.log (override with QAMART_PLUGIN_LOG).
